heroSummary: Most students on WCSD's 2025–26 Balanced Calendar started school August 11, 2025. Kindergarten began August 18 after a testing week. Fall Break was October 6–10, Winter Break was December 22–January 2, and the updated Spring Break was March 23–April 3. After snow closures on February 17–18, the final student day moved to June 8, 2026. June 9 was a no-student professional-development and election day, while June 10 remained a contingency day.

customSections.label: What WCSD Families Should Know About 2025–26
customSections.content: Four details distinguish the final archived calendar from both its earlier version and later WCSD school years.

groups.label: Kindergarten started later
items: Most students started August 11. Kindergarten testing ran August 11–15, and kindergarten's first classroom day was Monday, August 18.

groups.label: The calendar changed during the school year
items: WCSD's April 7 update records February 17–18 as Snow Days, moves Spring Break to March 23–April 3, and makes June 8 the final student day. June 9 became a no-student professional-development and Primary Election day; June 10 remained the contingency day.

groups.label: Professional-development days still counted
items: Students did not attend October 13, January 5, or June 9. WCSD counted those professional-development dates as school days in session under the note printed on the final calendar.

groups.label: Conference dates were not blanket closures
items: WCSD marked October 24 and October 27–30 as conference dates, but the calendar did not designate the entire period as a districtwide student holiday.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 11, 2026, against WCSD's final updated 2025–26 Balanced Calendar dated April 7, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: The April 7 PDF supersedes the earlier calendar version previously used for this page.
The final calendar records February 17–18 as Snow Days, Spring Break as March 23–April 3, and June 8 as the last student day.
June 9 is both a no-student professional-development day and Primary Election Day; June 10 is the remaining contingency day.
The earlier November 2023 calendar and WCSD's revision record are retained only to document how the archived calendar changed.

calendarFaqs.a: Most WCSD schools used the Balanced Calendar shown on this page. Students assigned to Gerlach, Incline, or TMCC followed separate official calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: When did WCSD start school in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Most students started Monday, August 11, 2025. Kindergarten testing ran August 11–15, and kindergarten's first classroom day was Monday, August 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When was WCSD Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break on the Balanced Calendar ran October 6–10, 2025. October 13 was a no-student professional-development day, and students returned October 14.

calendarFaqs.q: When was WCSD Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. January 5 was a no-student professional-development day, and students returned January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When was WCSD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The final updated Balanced Calendar lists Spring Break from March 23 through April 3, 2026. Students returned Monday, April 6.

calendarFaqs.q: What was the final day of WCSD in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The final updated Balanced Calendar ends Monday, June 8, 2026. June 9 was a no-student professional-development and Primary Election day, and June 10 remained a contingency day.

calendarFaqs.q: Why did the WCSD 2025–26 calendar change?
calendarFaqs.a: WCSD's April 7 update records snow closures on February 17–18 and revises the spring and year-end schedule. The final version moves the last student day to June 8 and leaves June 10 as the remaining contingency day.
